Our Story

UMI's Dairy Farm began with a simple belief in 1990 — that good food should come from a place you can trust. What started as a small family farm has grown into a name people rely on for milk, paneer, ghee, butter, and farm-raised poultry that taste the way they used to before mass production took over.

For over three decades, we've maintained the same commitment to quality that inspired us on day one. Every product we sell is rooted in care. Our cows are grazed and fed naturally, our milk is processed without shortcuts, and our paneer, ghee, and butter are made in small batches to preserve real flavor and nutrition. Our country chicken, hens, and eggs come from birds raised free-range, without growth hormones or artificial feed — the way farm poultry is meant to be raised.

We're not a factory. We're a farm — and every product that leaves our hands carries that difference. That's the UMI's Dairy Farm promise, generation after generation.
